name: Quick-Cooked Tomato Purée (Passata di Pomodoro)

instructions.primary_message: In a large saucepan, bring tomatoes bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until much of the excess liquid has cooked off but the tomatoes aren’t totally dry, about 15 minutes.

Transfer tomatoes and any juices a fine-mesh strainer or a food mill set with the finest strainer. over a large bowl. Strain the tomatoes of seeds and skin, pushing all the pulp and juices through; if straining by hand, use a wooden spoon and a scraping motion to pass the tomato flesh through into a bowl below. For an even smoother texture, pass the coulis once more through an even finer strainer.
Season with salt to taste. Use the tomato purée in any recipe calling for a tomato purée, or freeze for up to 6 months.

description: Turn ripe summer tomatoes into a fresh, flavorful tomato purée with this easy method. Use it for sauces now, or freeze it for up to 6 months.
notes: Make-ahead and storage: The purée can be frozen in an airtight container for up to 6 months.
author: Daniel Gritzer
